scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run scripts/with-env-run.ts bun --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.migrate: bun run scripts/with-env-run.ts bun apps/api/src/cli.ts migrate
scripts.collect: bun run scripts/with-env-run.ts bun apps/api/src/cli.ts collect
scripts.check: biome check . && bun run --cwd apps/web check
scripts.export: bun run scripts/with-env-run.ts bun apps/api/src/cli.ts export
